Aryan Khan's 'The Ba***ds of Bollywood' Season 2 Reportedly Set for March 2027

Aryan Khan's series 'The Ba***ds of Bollywood' is reportedly set for a second season, with production slated to begin in March 2027. The core cast from the first season is expected to return. Lakshya will reprise his role as Aasmaan Singh, alongside Sahher Bambba as Karishma Talvar, Bobby Deol as Ajay Talvar, Raghav Juyal as Parvaiz, and Anya Singh as Sanya.
